comment: Default rules of the writing linter. Override or extend them in ~/.claude/writing-rules/lint.json (all your projects) or .claude/writing-rules/lint.json (one project). See the README of the writing-rules repository.

rules.message: "rather than" reads as AI-generated; use "instead of" or restructure the sentence
em dash; use " - ", parentheses, commas or a new sentence, and vary between them
", not X" contrast; remove it if X adds nothing, otherwise state the positive claim first
"not merely/simply/just" contrast; state the claim positively
intensifier that reads as AI-generated; remove it
word associated with AI-generated text; name the actual thing or reformulate plainly

rules.pattern: \b(?:we|I) do not pursue this (?:connection|direction|question) further\b|\bThis is a position paper\b
rules.message: sentence about the paper instead of its content; remove it
